thread:
oncall-bot: PAGER — High GPU queue growth for inference-prod-eu on europe-west9. autoscaler failing to provision new nodes (quota/403). 15% request errors, tail latency > 5s. @alice you're oncall.

alice: acknowledged. pulling up autoscaler logs and quota dashboard. marking impact: customer-facing inference endpoints.

ben-sre: digging in. autoscaler shows repeated GCP API errors: 
```
ERROR 2024-11-03T08:12:21Z: compute.v1.globalOperations.insert -> quotaExceeded: Request was blocked due to quota limits.
project: redwood-inference-prod region: europe-west9 resource: gpu-n1-standard-16
```
Looks like regional GPU quota hit, attempts to create n1 nodes with GPU attachments returning 403.

maria-pm: how widespread? Which customers are affected? any high-SLA ones?

alice: currently routing to inference-prod-eu; requests queueing for model-small/medium; embeddings unaffected. Error rate ~15% and growing. A few high-volume customers seeing increased latencies and token timeouts.

devon: I can flip traffic to fallback-model-lite (lower GPU req) and enable degraded-mode until we free capacity. That should cut error rate but will reduce quality. need approval for automatic fallback.

maria-pm: do it. notify affected customers. prioritize SLOs.

ben-sre: attempting quick mitigations:
- reprovision attempts failing (quotaExceeded).
- checked GCP console: GPU regional quota at 100% for nvidia-a100; request increase already pending (submitted 5h ago).
- trying cross-region failover to europe-west4 where we have spare quota. prepping routing change.

infra-bot: autoscaler event stream: 
```
[08:14:03] scaleAttempt failure -> 403 quotaExceeded (gpu count 0->8)
[08:15:12] scaleAttempt failure -> 403 quotaExceeded (gpu count 0->16)
[08:17:39] fallbackPool invoked: reserved-capacity eu-west4 available=12
```

alice: ben, can you confirm if eu-west4 nodes are compatible (same kernel, driver, model artifacts)? risk of cache cold start?

ben-sre: eu-west4 has same image + drivers. KV cache will be cold; expect initial latency spike for long-tail users. We can mitigate by warming small canaries.

devon: I'll kick off a controlled route shift: 20% traffic -> eu-west4 canaries, warm model caches, then ramp to 80% if stable. rolling update script:
```
./route-shift --from=inference-prod-eu --to=inference-prod-eu-west4 --percent=20 --wait=120
```

alice: do it. watch errors and latency. if errors > 5% or latency > 10s pause and rollback.

maria-pm: customer comms draft: "We've detected elevated latency/errors in EU inference due to GPU quota exhaustion in europe-west9. We're routing traffic to a secondary region and enabling degraded-mode for some models. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline." Approving.

ben-sre: rolling route shift started. Initial warm canaries successful. error rate dropped from 15% -> 6% on shifted traffic. overall error rate now 8%.

infra-bot: quota increase request status: PENDING (GCP case 12345678). ETA unknown.

alice: long-term fixes: 1) request permanent quota bump 2) add automated multi-region failover policy when regional GPU quota > 90% 3) surface quota headroom in console and autoscaler. Adding to backlog and tagging as P0 for dedicated infra.

devon: also enabling temporary degraded-model fallback for non-SLA customers to reduce GPU pressure. will annotate rollout.

maria-pm: opening incident postmortem ticket. include customer impact metrics and timeline.

ben-sre: monitoring: queue depth trending down after route shift. continuing to watch for regressions.

alice: ok handing off to night oncall (devon) for monitoring and customer comms. I'm going offline for the next 3h.

devon: acknowledged. will keep an eye on autoscaler and GCP quota case. will escalate to GCP support if ETA slips.

oncall-bot: Incident: gpu-quota-europe-west9 scaledown-mitigation -> status = mitigated (traffic shifted). follow-up: postmortem required.

alice: thanks team. short follow-ups: record which customers saw degraded fidelity, update runbook with cross-region route steps, and ensure reserved capacity thresholds are visible.

ben-sre: noted. I'll attach logs and the route-shift command output to the postmortem ticket.

maria-pm: good job. closing this pager thread in 30m after we confirm stabilization. :thumbsup:
